# Page

The guard clauses at the top of `getWoundThreshold` (`module/utils/wounds.js`) return early. The whole file is `module/utils/wounds.js`.
`WoundTrack#draw` (`module/utils/wounds.js`) draws `.l5r4-wound-track` (`scss/components/_wound-track.scss`) titled `l5r4.wounds.title` (`lang/en.json`).
Core's stylesheet sets it (`foundry2.css:4126-4130`, `:4140`), and core reads it [src: client/dice/roll.mjs:933] (`client/applications/api/dialog.mjs:346-405`), in its frame (`resources/app/templates/app-window.html:1`).
A file the tree lacks is doc-path's job: `anything` (`templates/gone.hbs`).
